text.p: These are the highlights of stories in Macedonian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Police did not exceed their authority when intervening in Gostivar, the Macedonian Ministry of Interior report said. A special team will investigate the allegations that the police have abused authority.
- The government has replaced managers in all the republic's public utility enterprises.

- Albania will be open to all neighbours, president of the Albanian Socialist Party Fatos Nano said in an interview. Incidents like in Gostivar only create tensions but peace and cool temper must be preserved, he said.
- Authorities register 253 cattle brucelossis cases in Kumanovo municipality. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
